title: THC Advanced Water Quality and Irrigation Certificate
publicDesignation: THC Advanced Water Quality and Irrigation Certificate

assessmentModel.knowledgeAssessment: Randomized advanced water-quality and irrigation assessment mapped to six course objectives; credential use remains blocked until bank depth, review, pilot evidence and standard-setting are complete.
assessmentModel.retakePolicy: Maximum attempts and cooldown must follow the current approved course assessment configuration once validation is complete.
assessmentModel.completionEvidence: Course completion and final-assessment result must be retained in the Academy learner record.
assessmentModel.performanceEvidence: The required Technician II water-delivery and root-zone troubleshooting practical must be passed with no critical errors and verified evidence artifacts.

limitations: Does not authorize unapproved input changes, plumbing or electrical repair, or work outside assigned workplace authority.
Does not replace employer procedures, equipment manufacturer requirements, regulated-worker qualifications, discharge requirements or jurisdiction-specific rules.
Documents Academy educational/workforce achievement and is not an independent personnel certification or government license.
